name: Le Nikaal Photu
visual_description: Saurabh Shukla lifting his shirt to expose his belly in anger while a cameraman tries to film/photograph him.
usage_context: Used to show complete shamelessness, defiance, or daring someone to expose or document your flaws/absurd behavior.

example.top_text: When HR threatens to record me coming 2 hours late every day

text_areas.description: Situation provoking shameless defiance or exposure
